title: ...un-box a brand new computer
desc: Clean up bloatware and secure your operating system on day one.
todos: Run system update utility until no OS updates remain.
Uninstall pre-installed OEM bloatware and trial antivirus software.
Enable BitLocker or FileVault full-disk encryption.
Create a non-administrator daily user account for regular web browsing.
Set up automatic system recovery restore points and external backup target.
